enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Guardbreaking: This item enables you to break an enemy's guard in between your melee attacks. On critical hits with your melee weapons, enemies will become dazed as a result.
Freedom of Movement: This item grants its wearer the ability to move and attack normally while under the influence of magic that impedes movement, such as paralysis, solid fog, slow and web.
Spell Save +10: This item gives a +10 Resistance bonus to your saves versus spells.
Spell Resistance +38: +38 Enhancement bonus to Spell Resistance.

Crystal: Crystal weapons are able to overcome the protective damage reduction of many Quori creatures, which can be resistant to other weapons. Spell failure chances for armors and shields made from crystal are also decreased by 10%.
